headline: Callahan's Gate Returns to Colonial Hands; Stonecradle Fighting Swells
war_summary: Callahan's Gate has crossed back: the latest event in the Dead Lands, logged shortly after eight this morning, leaves all eleven of that region's strategic posts in Colonial hands, undoing the Warden hold reported only hours before, though losses there remain heavy on both sides even as the pace cools. The Weathered Expanse stays the war's busiest ground — twenty-seven recorded events in a day, Frostmarch and Crow's Nest worked hardest — yet the map holds five Colonial posts to four Warden. In Stonecradle the ledger darkens: casualties are climbing steeply, Warden losses outpacing Colonial, with World's End the most contested post on a six-to-three Colonial map. The Linn of Mercy churns on around Lathair, ten Colonial stations to one Warden, Warden casualties heavier; Stlican Shelf's six-to-three Warden footing quiets after a bloody day. Mooring County's flags have stilled since the small hours, all twelve posts Warden, while the Nevish Line's thunderhead settles to a simmer and Callahans Passage keeps its grinding toll. No victor is declared; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
